B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators are not already aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting.
Tag for mixed-number problems if only the fractional parts need denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of denominator alignment with no equivalent-fraction conversion.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless denominator matching is also performed.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they share a denominator, including cases where the result is zero or already simplified.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators over a common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after denominators are already the same or have been aligned.
Tag when the fraction subtraction yields 0/d or a proper fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag denominator-finding or equivalent-fraction conversion steps by themselves.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that create a new fractional amount before subtraction.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction unless subtraction itself is shown.

skills.name: Subtract mixed-number parts
skills.definition: Subtract whole-number parts and fractional parts separately when working with mixed numbers or whole-number-plus-fraction forms without needing regrouping.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution splits numbers into whole and fractional parts and subtracts each part directly.
Tag when a whole number is treated as having a zero fractional part for partwise subtraction.
Tag when the mixed-number subtraction proceeds without borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag if the key operation is regrouping/borrowing because the fractional part would go negative.
Do not tag pure fraction subtraction with no whole-number parts.
Do not tag final recombination alone unless the step also performs the partwise subtraction.

skills.name: Borrow in subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole-number part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is rewritten as d/d or an equivalent fractional amount and added to the existing fraction part.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in a mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction problem.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary partwise subtraction when no regrouping occurs.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless a whole is explicitly borrowed during subtraction.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed number
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number whose fractional part is improper as an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a form like a b/c with b >= c is converted to an equivalent mixed number with a proper fractional part.
Tag when the normalization changes the whole-number part before subtraction begins.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag conversion to equivalent fractions for common denominators.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping during subtraction.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d.

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms or convert a zero-valued fraction to 0.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly reduces a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5.
Tag when the solution simplifies 0/d to 0.
Tag when a non-lowest-term fractional part of a mixed-number result is simplified.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag results that are already in lowest terms with no explicit simplification step.
Do not tag subtraction itself.
Do not tag combining whole and fractional parts unless simplification is explicitly performed.

A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators are not already aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions to create like denominators.
Tag for mixed-number problems if only the fractional parts are being rewritten to common denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere rewriting of a whole number as a mixed number with 0 over a denominator unless equivalent-fraction conversion is also done.
Do not tag borrowing steps that add one whole denominator-unit to a fraction part.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a 0-fraction part or converting a mixed number with an improper fraction part to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fractional parts to set up subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion between proper fractions.
Do not tag the final recombination of whole and fractional parts.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has produced a negative fractional part.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the common denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when two fractions with the same denominator are subtracted directly.
Tag when the fractional parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after denominators are already aligned.
Tag whether the result is positive, zero, or initially negative.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding or creating a common denominator.
Do not tag subtraction of whole-number parts alone.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction unless subtraction itself is shown.

skills.name: Subtract mixed parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number parts and fractional parts of mixed-number or whole-number expressions componentwise when no regrouping is needed yet.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver separately computes whole-part subtraction and fraction-part subtraction.
Tag when one operand is a whole number treated as having a 0-fraction part and the parts are subtracted separately.
Tag even if the fractional difference is negative and regrouping will be needed in a later step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction subtraction with no whole parts.
Do not tag the later borrowing/regrouping step that fixes a negative fractional part.
Do not tag the final combine step alone.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as denominator-over-denominator and add it to the fractional part when the fractional subtraction in a mixed-number setup would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is borrowed from the whole part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted to a fraction such as 5/5, 10/10, 12/12, or 24/24 and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when regrouping is used in mixed number minus mixed number, whole minus mixed number, or whole minus fraction contexts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when the fractional part is already large enough.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction.
Do not tag simplification after regrouped subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Simplify and express
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, whole number, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is simplified to lowest terms.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is rewritten as 0.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into a final mixed number or integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction step itself unless the step also explicitly performs simplification or final recombination.
Do not tag setup steps such as finding common denominators or rewriting operands.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping unless the step's main purpose is final expression of the answer.
